result.summary: Found 2 visually broken issues: one clear data/content bug and one layout issue where content appears obscured by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The delivery fee for “Smash Bros Burgers” is displayed as “€NaN delivery”, indicating a broken or missing numeric value.
issues.suggestion: Add validation/fallback handling for missing delivery-fee data, such as showing “Free delivery”, “Delivery fee unavailable”, or hiding the fee until a valid value is returned.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the lower restaurant card, cutting off the pizza image/content at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are not hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation.
